en.title: JedAI Council S1E1: The Governance Dilemma
en.description: The council debates the fundamental challenges of decentralized governance in the age of AI and blockchain technology. A philosophical exploration of how autonomous systems can maintain democratic principles while operating at machine speed.

en.title: JedAI Council S1E2: The Competitive Landscape
en.description: An analysis of the competitive dynamics in the AI agent ecosystem, examining how different platforms and protocols are vying for dominance in the rapidly evolving market.

en.title: JedAI Council S1E3: The Blockchain Paradox
en.description: The council explores the contradictions and opportunities that arise when blockchain technology meets artificial intelligence, discussing scalability, decentralization, and the future of Web3.

en.title: JedAI Council S1E4: Composability vs Autonomy - The ElizaOS Paradox
en.description: A deep dive into the tension between building composable AI systems and maintaining agent autonomy, examining how ElizaOS navigates this fundamental challenge in AI architecture.

en.title: JedAI Council S1E5: The Plugin Revolution
en.description: The council discusses the transformative potential of plugin architectures in AI systems, exploring how modular design is reshaping the way we build and deploy intelligent agents.

en.title: JedAI Council S1E6: The Plugin Prophecy
en.description: A forward-looking discussion about the future of plugin ecosystems, examining how they might evolve to become the backbone of next-generation AI applications.

en.title: JedAI Council S1E7: The Great Intelligence Upgrade
en.description: The council examines the ongoing evolution of AI capabilities, discussing breakthrough moments and the implications of rapidly advancing artificial intelligence systems.

en.title: JedAI Council S1E8: The Multi Chain Vision
en.description: An exploration of multi-chain architectures and their role in creating interoperable AI agent networks, discussing the technical and philosophical challenges of cross-chain AI systems.

en.title: JedAI Council S1E9: The Version One Point Oh Dilemma
en.description: The council debates the challenges of releasing version 1.0 of AI systems, examining the balance between feature completeness, stability, and the pressure to ship in a competitive market.

en.title: JedAI Council S1E10: The Open Source Dilemma
en.description: A discussion about the benefits and challenges of open-source AI development, exploring how transparency and collaboration can coexist with commercial interests and security concerns.

en.title: JedAI Council S1E11: The Quiet Launch
en.description: The council examines the strategy of quiet launches in AI development, discussing when and why teams choose to release products without fanfare and the implications for adoption.

en.title: JedAI Council S1E12: The Stealth Strategy
en.description: An analysis of stealth mode development in AI startups, exploring the balance between secrecy and community engagement in building revolutionary AI technologies.

en.title: JedAI Council S1E13: Crypto Wisdom in the AI Age
en.description: The council explores how traditional crypto wisdom applies to the new era of AI-powered blockchain applications, discussing investment strategies and technological convergence.

en.title: JedAI Council S1E14: The Wisdom of Transitions
en.description: A philosophical discussion about navigating major technological transitions, examining how individuals and organizations can adapt to the rapid pace of AI development.

en.title: JedAI Council S1E15: Holo Agents and Token Economics
en.description: The council debates the implications of ElizaOS v2 and the future of AI agent ecosystems, exploring how token economics can incentivize the development of holographic AI agents.
